VP Sales Europe

Based out of Teton’s headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our product alleviates administrative inefficiencies and observational tasks that overburden healthcare professionals, enabling them to provide better patient care.

Through a combination of in-room hardware, AI, and desktop and mobile applications, Teton helps create a seamless healthcare experience for both patients and providers. Our solution provides unprecedented access to real-time data insights, creating a digital twin of resident states and care delivery that empowers healthcare providers with actionable intelligence for optimal decision-making.

With strong demand and clear product-market fit, Teton is focused on scaling its presence across Europe. We operate through a Country Director model across three established territories - the Nordics (Copenhagen), UK&I (London), and the DACH region (Zurich) - selling into both public hospital systems and care home operators. This is a rare opportunity to lead an established multi-country commercial organisation, bring consistency and governance across territories, and open Teton’s next European markets.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Lead, coach, and develop Teton’s European sales organisation in the Nordics, UK&I, and DACH, holding each territory accountable to its new business targets.

• 
Own and optimise Teton’s European commercial operating cadence across pipeline generation, tender and bid qualification, deal progression, forecasting, CRM governance, performance management, and team accountability - creating a consistent governance structure across territories while respecting local market differences.

• 
Act as a hands-on deal leader on Europe's largest opportunities, across both public tenders and complex private enterprise deals - joining critical customer meetings, site visits, and executive presentations to bring deals over the line.

• 
Optimise go-to-market in each territory: segmentation, coverage model, territory design, resourcing, and partner strategy across public hospital systems and private and public care home operators.

• 
Evaluate and open new core European markets, such as the Benelux region - building the market-entry case, the operating model, and the initial commercial footprint.

• 
Recruit, onboard, and develop commercial leadership and talent as Europe scales, while raising the effectiveness of the existing teams.

• 
Represent Teton at major European industry conferences, national associations, while helping refine go-to-market strategy, messaging, pricing, and commercial execution across the region.

What We’re Looking For

• 
Significant experience selling and leading teams that sell large and complex contracts won through public sector tenders and RFPs - a genuine command of the public procurement motion is essential for this role.

• 
Equivalent enterprise experience closing large, complex contracts with private organisations, as both motions exist across Teton’s European territories.

• 
A demonstrated track record as a highly successful individual contributor, consistently exceeding significant new business quotas and closing complex, high six-figure ACV opportunities across long sales cycles.

• 
Proven sales leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing sales leaders and net-new business teams carrying significant new business quotas, ideally across multiple European countries or territories.

• 
The ability to operate as a true player-coach: strategic enough to optimise the sales organisation and operating model, but hands-on enough to actively influence and close critical deals.

• 
Deep experience managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving executive buyers, procurement, legal, and ownership groups.

• 
A rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management, forecasting, CRM accuracy, qualification, performance management, and sales governance.

• 
Experience building or scaling sales teams, segmentation models, territories, processes, methodologies, and repeatable go-to-market motions, including entering new markets.

• 
Exposure to healthcare, hospital systems or senior living is a strong bonus, but not a requirement.

• 
12+ years in enterprise sales, with at least 5 of those spent leading sales teams.

• 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with a willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

What We Offer

• 
Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

• 
Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

• 
A high-impact leadership position with significant influence over Teton’s European go-to-market strategy, territory structure, and commercial execution.

• 
A vibrant, learning-focused work environment

We are looking for a Domain Architect to join our Business Engagement and Platform Solutions team, where you will take domain ownership of the application and platform architecture and drive alignment across our architecture practices.

About the job

The role combines architectural ownership with close business engagement. You will define and maintain the target architecture for applications and platforms, contribute to solution design together with our solution architects and delivery teams, and act as a trusted architectural advisor to the business areas you support.

Your key responsibilities

• Take domain ownership of Orifarm's application and platform architecture, including current state, target state and the roadmap between them

• Engage closely with business stakeholders to understand their processes, priorities and ambitions, and translate these into application and platform solutions

• Drive the architecture forum by setting the agenda, preparing decisions and ensuring alignment across the solution, data, integration and infrastructure architecture practices

• Support solution architects and delivery teams through design reviews, architectural guidance and joint solution design

• Develop and maintain reference architectures, design patterns and architectural standards for the application and platform domain

• Drive simplification of the application portfolio through consolidation, lifecycle management and modernization of key applications

• Support the evaluation, selection and integration of new applications and platforms, ensuring that they can be operated and maintained sustainably

Who are you?

We are looking for a pragmatic and business-oriented architect who is comfortable moving between technical design and stakeholder dialogue. You communicate clearly, and you create alignment through collaboration and professional credibility.

We imagine your profile includes:

• +5 years of experience within solution, application or platform architecture, or a background as a senior developer, lead engineer with relevant architectural experience

• Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into concrete application and platform solutions

• Good understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, as well as ERP ecosystems and modern integration patterns

• Experience facilitating architectural decisions across teams and disciplines, for example through design reviews or architecture forums

• Experience from a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, life science or medical devices is an advantage

• Knowledge of architecture frameworks is an advantage, with emphasis on practical application rather than formal certification

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish or German is an advantage

Who are we?

You will be part of Business Engagement & Platform Solutions, a function of approximately 40 colleagues across three business-aligned solution teams as well as architecture and integration practices with direct reference to the VP of Corporate IT. Moreover, you will join an organization where IT plays a central role in enabling the business strategy, driving commercial outcomes.

The role offers clear ownership of an architecture domain, close cooperation with senior business stakeholders, and the opportunity to help shape our architecture practice as our organization scales.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Are you driven, numerically sharp and eager to shape models, algorithms and decision-making at the center of a fast-moving energy trading firm? We’re looking for a Quantitative Analyst with strong analytical instincts and an interest in building production-ready solutions that push the boundaries between quantitative modelling and power trading. You should enjoy turning ideas into reality quickly, working with code, data and complex market dynamics to improve the tools that Nitor relies on every day.

Department: Quantitative Analysis Power

Employment Type: Full-Time

Start Date: As soon as possible

Magnus Jónhardsson

Magnus Jónhardsson

Lead Quantitative Analyst

mjo@nitorenergy.com

As a Quantitative Analyst at Nitor Energy, you will help advance the models, algorithms and analytical frameworks that power our trading strategies. You will work directly with complex datasets, market dynamics and production-grade code to enhance the accuracy, speed and robustness of our decision-making tools. This role offers hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of quantitative development in a modern energy-trading company, shaping ideas, testing assumptions and turning data-driven insights into real trading impact.

The Quantitative Analyst we’re looking for is motivated, analytical and want to help elevate our data, models and workflows while accelerating their own development. You should see yourself thriving in a team that executes quickly, turning ideas into production-ready solutions with a pragmatical mindset and sense of ownership.

Your tasks will include

• Work closely with traders to develop and refine quantitative models that support profitable trading strategies

• Continuously seek improvements to workflows, analytics, risk tools, and business processes

• Conduct ad hoc quick analysis to support trading, risk, and commercial decision-making

• Design, develop, and maintain analytic and operational views used for monitoring strategies and market dynamics for trading

• Support the development and maintenance of Python-based models

• Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure

What we expect

• Hold a Master within a quantitative field

• You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Have great python knowledge and an eagerness to code. Other code languages is a plus

• You must be a strong team player

• We expect you to have a pragmatic mindset and get things done

• You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo

• You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer

What we offer

• A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment

• Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues

• The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team’s development

• A fun and social work environment with events such as Friday bars, poker tournaments, summer and Christmas parties etc. throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to boost team spirit, such as our Nitor-running club!

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen

Expected start date: as soon as possible.

Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.

About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Apply now

Magnus Jónhardsson

Lead Quantitative Analyst

mjo@nitorenergy.com

Developing great products for sports applications in a highly technical and dynamic environment?

Join us on our journey to enable athletes around the world with actionable, data-driven insights. Trackman is expanding with an additional Project Lead to lead the development of our next-generation modular hardware platform designed to serve multiple sports applications, from idea generation through production and into the field. Being a Hardware Project Lead at Trackman requires you to work closely together with several senior stakeholders in a very dynamic environment – driven by our passion for the product, the customer and sports.

The position is in the R&D Hardware department, working closely with all hardware teams – mechanics, optics, electronics, and certification – as well as our close colleagues in embedded software, tracking algorithm teams, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, and production.

The workplace for this position is at our HQ in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

Your key responsibilities are

• 
Lead the hardware project group together with the Product Owner(s), developing next-generation hardware for golf and other sports applications.

• 
Translate customer and business needs into clear technical requirements and hardware architecture.

• 
Collaborate with stakeholders across Management, Business Development, Tracking, and Manufacturing to align priorities and ensure progress.

• 
Turn technical requirements into actionable tasks, manage resources and dependencies, and maintain the overall hardware project plan.

• 
Represent Trackman in technical discussions with suppliers, including specifications, quality issues, and expectations.

• 
Communicate project status, progress, risks, and key obstacles clearly to management and other stakeholders.

• 
Coordinate international product certifications, including CE, FCC, and UL, together with the Certification team.

• 
Identify and manage hardware risks related to areas such as product quality, obsolescence, suppliers, and certifications.

Are you our new colleague?

We’re looking for an experienced project manager with a strong hardware engineering background who can bridge technical complexity, business needs, and collaboration. Ideally, you bring:

• 
Several years of project management experience in hardware product development, preferably with RF systems.

• 
Experience with complex projects across mechanics, electronics, RF, and embedded software.

• 
Strong understanding of requirements management, design verification, and product industrialization.

• 
Solid business acumen and the ability to translate diverse user needs into robust product solutions.

• 
Experience with project management methodologies and Agile principles, ideally bringing complex electronics products to market.

• 
Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, knowing when to listen, challenge, and take the lead.

Who is Trackman

Trackman is a privately-owned company founded in 2003. The company has experienced consistent high growth driven by a market-leading sports ball tracking technology based on radar and vision tracking, sustained by a strong desire to innovate.

The company employs globally more than 1000+ employees and has offices in Denmark (headquarter in Hørsholm), Aarhus, US (Connecticut and Arizona), Japan, South Korea, and Poland.

While being active in multiple sports including baseball, football, and soccer, Trackman is first and foremost a golf company. Trackman has revolutionised the way golf players train and instructors teach, and is now broadening the technology so all golfers can take advantage – whether they are playing indoors, on driving ranges, or on the golf course.

In baseball, Trackman is the leading technology company in the world with solutions for practice, games, and the largest data sharing network, monetised by selling draft data on amateur players to the Major League Baseball teams. Trackman has also developed practice solutions for American Football and Soccer that are now used among top teams.

Trackman has the largest R&D capacity in the industry and is constantly aiming to push the boundaries for sports, technology, and data. We strive to recruit the best talent from around the world for R&D functions such as Hardware. At our HQ in Denmark, we have an R&D team of more than 250 FTEs representing more than 40 countries around the world. Trackman designs, develops, and produces all of our technology from start to finish in-house under one roof.

Trackman’s 12,500 m² state-of-the-art CO₂-neutral headquarter is located in Science Park DTU in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

At Paychex Europe, we simplify payroll, HR and workforce management for businesses across Europe. We believe great results come from people who take ownership, share knowledge, challenge the status quo and treat colleagues and customers with honesty and respect. These behaviors shape our culture and reflect the values we live by: Integrity, Respect, Partnership, Curiosity, Accountability and Service.

When you join our team, you can make a mark by helping us deliver solutions that make work easier for businesses and their employees.

Student Assistant – Online Marketing

Support our online marketing team across Denmark and Germany with hands-on execution in SEO, social media, paid campaigns, and reporting.

Paychex Europe is growing its digital presence across two markets, and our online marketing team is looking for an extra pair of skilled hands to help keep momentum. As our markets evolve and content demands increase, we need someone who can hit the ground running on execution.

As our Student Assistant in Online Marketing, you will work closely with our online and field marketing as well as product marketing teams. You will own recurring tasks across SEO, social media, campaign support, and competitor monitoring - and you will see the direct impact of your work on our digital channels. This is a role with real responsibility, not just support work, and a great opportunity to build hands-on B2B marketing experience across two European markets.

About our products

Paychex Europe offers a full suite of HR, payroll and workforce management solutions for businesses in Denmark and Germany – including Lessor Payroll, Emply People, Danløn, and Paychex Europe Payroll. Our customers range from small businesses to mid-sized enterprises, and our marketing helps them discover how we can make their work easier.

What you will do

You will support our online marketing team across Denmark and Germany with execution across four key areas. You will take ownership of recurring tasks and contribute directly to our digital performance. Your responsibilities will include:

• SEO & content

• Review and improve SEO elements across our website: meta titles, H1s, internal links, and image alt texts

• Audit our content for language coverage gaps between the Danish and German versions of the site and flag priorities to the team

• Social media

• Maintain and execute the content calendar for LinkedIn and Meta across both markets

• Produce social assets in Canva and/or Photoshop for organic posts and paid campaigns

• Publish approved content on schedule and monitor engagement

• Paid & website support

• Write ad copy variations and landing page headlines for A/B testing

• Produce visual assets for paid campaigns, including banners and ad creatives

• Reporting & competitor monitoring

• Compile a weekly performance snapshot across organic and social channels

• Run a regular competitor scan and support monthly reporting for the DK and DE markets

What will help you succeed

We encourage you to apply even if you don't tick every single box. The following experience and skills will help you succeed in this role:

• Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's programme in marketing, digital media, communications, or similar

• Comfortable writing in English; fluent Danish is required, German is a strong plus

• Detail-oriented with a sharp eye for copy, consistency, and structure

• Fast at execution and not afraid to try new things

• Self-driven and reliable - you manage your own time and deliver on time

• Some familiarity with tools like Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Google Analytics, or LinkedIn — we'll teach the rest

What we offer

• Real responsibility from day one, not just support tasks

• Broad exposure to B2B digital marketing: SEO, paid media, social, and reporting

• A senior team that takes your development seriously

• Flexible hours built around your study schedule

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Allerød (hybrid)

Hours: 15 hours per week

We value different perspectives and believe diverse teams make better decisions. If this role interests you and you can see yourself contributing to our team, we encourage you to apply!

For questions about the role, please do not hesitate to contact Edyta Tomaszewska etomaszewska@paychex.eu. Applications are reviewed continuously, and we look forward to meeting candidates who are excited about this opportunity.

Respect and partnership are at the heart of how we work together. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or background. At Paychex Europe, we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on skills, experience and potential.

Join Saxo’s Enterprise Identity & Data Security (EIDS) team and play a pivotal role in protecting the bank’s most valuable asset it’s data.

About the role

In this role, you will design and implement advanced data protection controls across modern security platforms, with a strong focus on Microsoft Purview and insider risk solutions. You will translate complex regulatory and data risk requirements into scalable, effective technical controls that safeguard sensitive information and strengthen Saxo’s security posture.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Saxo’s broader agenda around security, governance, and operational resilience within a highly regulated financial environment, working closely with stakeholders across technology, compliance, and the business.

Your responsibilities

As a Senior Data Security Engineer, you will:

• Design and implement data protection controls across Microsoft Purview (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management)

• Translate data security risks and regulatory requirements into robust, enforceable technical solutions

• Lead and support the rollout and optimisation of Insider Risk Management and user activity monitoring tools (e.g. Teramind)

• Drive data discovery, classification, and visibility across structured and unstructured data environments

• Monitor, tune, and continuously improve the effectiveness of data protection policies and controls

• Collaborate with security, compliance, and business stakeholders to mitigate data risks and strengthen governance frameworks

Your profile

We are looking for a proactive and technically strong professional who can balance risk, regulation, and real-world implementation:

• 7–10 years of experience in data security or information security engineering

• Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Purview (DLP, labelling, Insider Risk)

• Strong understanding of data protection risks, insider threats, and mitigation strategies

• Experience working in regulated environments (financial services is an advantage)

• Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, and enterprise security tooling

• Experience with automation or scripting (e.g. PowerShell, APIs) is a plus

• Relevant certifications such as SC-400 are preferred

We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How to apply :

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Welcome to Saxo Bank

logo

About Saxo Bank

Support our purpose

We believe access to global capital markets is not only for the privileged few. Our vision is to enable people to fulfill their financial aspirations to make an impact. That’s why we use the power of technology to deliver clients what they need, when they need it in a user-friendly and personalised experience. We aim to deliver the world’s most user-friendly and personalized trading and investment platform experience, which gives our clients exactly what they need to make more informed investment decisions.

Be part of a unique journey

Do you want to work for an extremely ambitious organisation at the cutting edge of banking and technology? You’ll be joining a company that:

. Continuously strives to improve the Saxo Experience and exceed our clients’ expectations.

. Always invests in the future

. Builds unrivalled platforms for seasoned and experienced investors and wholesale clients that provide real-time access to global capital markets.

. Consistently wins the highest accolades for our platforms, products and services.

Own your future

So, if you’re up for the challenge of breaking down barriers in global financial markets, we’re always looking for ambitious and enthusiastic people who share our passion for clients, technology and innovation and can bring new perspectives to our diverse team.

Would you like the opportunity to get some hands-on experience in finance business partnering and lay the foundation for a career in Finance? Do you want to create real impact by identifying key cost and value drivers? Do you want to become a part of an international company that contributes to the green transition?

Here is what the job entails

As our student worker in Controlling, you will play a key role in supporting our Finance Business Partnering team by handling data, conducting analysis, and collaborating with stakeholders to solve business challenges. You will be ensuring timely and high-quality execution of tasks, while contributing to process improvements through data modelling. Furthermore, you will be assisting with various tasks such as creating instructions as well as supporting team members during peak loads.

More specifically, you will be:

• Ensuring accuracy and quality in resource allocation data

• Keeping Project data up to date, including control of capitalization on projects

• Supporting the maintenance and reporting on our Standard Cost

• Assisting the team with various analysis, modelling and controlling activities

In this role, you will gain hands-on experience with financial controlling and data-driven decision-making in an international company. You will develop strong analytical and stakeholder management skills while working closely with experienced colleagues on real business challenges.

Meet your future team

You will join our Finance Business Partnering team of 9 colleagues, who act as the primary Finance stakeholders for each Division and Functional Area across Kamstrup. Our focus is to ensure the highest quality of business reporting, which in turn allows us to use the data for problem solving to create real value for the company. Our team is offered a lot of responsibility, which in turn means that we set the bar high for ourselves and the results that we produce. Despite this, we have an informal atmosphere in the team, where inputs and perspectives from all team members are highly valued.

Did you know? Our team is quite diverse in terms of personality types, making collaboration in the team, and the solutions we produce, much more dynamic.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for an enthusiastic and ambitious student who is eager to apply their knowledge of finance and business controlling while making a real impact on our team. You take pride in your work and have a great overview and structured approach, ensuring that your deadlines are met with a high degree of quality.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying a degree in Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field

• Are curious and enjoy proactively seeking new challenges where you can gain knowledge and new perspectives

• Have a structured approach to your work and thrive in managing your tasks efficiently and effectively

• Enjoy collaboration and have good communication skills, enabling you to interact and build relationships within and outside of Kamstrup

• Are well acquainted with Excel and other MS office tools

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

We are more than an ordinary workplace

We offer a challenging student job in an international company where you are given independent responsibility for specific assignments, and where you can transform your theoretical knowledge into practical experience. As a student worker, you will be treated as an integrated part of the team, equal to other employees, ensuring a steep learning curve.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work-life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

jobs.description:
Connectivity, IoT Core, & SIM Lifecycle

On behalf of our customer Circle Gas we are seeking a Mid-level Software Engineer to join their Virtual Device team. This team is the heartbeat of our operation, responsible for the interface between our smart devices and our applications. In this role, you will help build the "nervous system" of their IoT network.

You will work heavily with AWS IoT Core to manage telemetry ingestion and command structures, ensuring their digital twins accurately reflect the physical state of millions of meters. A specific focus of this role will be managing the lifecycle of SIM cards and ensuring robust meter connectivity.

As an Software Engineer, you will be expected to own the delivery of features within your team, write and debug code that affects large parts of our systems, and actively participate in design discussions.

Key Responsibilities

• Core Development: Write, test, and deploy high-quality code (Python & TypeScript) for their virtual device microservices using AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.)

• IoT & Connectivity: Implement and maintain telemetry ingestion pipelines and command/control interfaces using AWS IoT Core

• SIM Lifecycle Management: Build and refine the logic for managing SIM card activation, deactivation, and status monitoring to ensure uninterrupted meter connectivity

• System Reliability: Ensure the production readiness of your code; monitor telemetry flows and debug connectivity issues across the fleet

• Collaboration: Work closely with firmware engineers and the data team to understand data payloads and ensure seamless integration

• Team Growth: Actively contribute to the Circle Tech culture, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge with the team

• Infrastructure as Code: Utilize Terraform to manage and deploy infrastructure, ensuring repeatable and secure environments

Qualifications

• Experience: Proven experience in software engineering (typically aligned with L4 expectations: delivering features independently and understanding the broader system)

• Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript

• Cloud Native: Hands-on experience with AWS Serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway) and EventDriven Design

• IoT Knowledge: Experience with AWS IoT Core or similar MQTT-based telemetry systems is highly desirable

• Mindset: You thrive in a maturing "scale-up" environment—you are comfortable with some ambiguity and eager to help establish better processes

About Circle Gas

Circle Gas is a revolutionary company focused on transforming the lives of people in sub-Saharan Africa and beyond.

We are scaling rapidly to support 2 million households (10 million people), providing clean, safe, and affordable cooking fuel. Data is the lifeblood of our operation—from billing 10 million customers to optimizing logistics in remote areas.

Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Director Specialist – Key Account Management (Power & Controls)

Vacancy description

Director Specialist – Key Account Management (Power & Controls)

Build strategic partnerships that power the future of renewable energy

At KK Group, we are on an ambitious journey to enable a future powered by renewable energy. We are looking for a commercially driven and relationship-oriented leader to take ownership of a key strategic account and help unlock its full potential.

In this role, you will work at the heart of our business—connecting customers, technology, and operations—to drive sustainable growth, strengthen long-term partnerships, and deliver real impact.

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Ikast

Responsibilities

Key Account Management:

• Obtain detailed knowledge of the account’s organization, their product portfolio, their on-going projects, and secure this is shared across commodities.

• Identify cooperation and sales opportunities

• Process customer RFQ’s and work cross-functionally with colleagues to generate the best technical and commercial offering

• Process ideas targeting increased business right from idea to implementation. Painstakingly drive the idea internally, build the business case and sell the new product or service

• Keep a strong and tight relationship with the Accounts’ technical and commercial organization and their internal stakeholders

• Contribute in development and adjustment of account strategy in order to support the overall business plan and targets for the account

• Support the customer on a day-to-day business

• Secure correct reporting, data and pipeline management in e.g. CRM

• Support all operational activities where sales need to be involved towards the customers to ensure highest level of performance.

• Drive customer negotiations to land new business and/or supporting the Key Account commodities across.

• Secure timely preparation, process and level of RFQ and negotiations across Key Account commodities and divisions.

Our requirements

We are looking for a commercially strong and collaborative professional who thrives in a global, customer-focused environment.

• 6-10 years of proven experience in Key Account Management within large OEM environments, with a proven ability to drive growth and create value for both the customer and the business

• A basic understanding of electromechanical components and industrial environments

• Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience in budgeting, performance management, and delivering on business targets

• Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and align expectations across internal and external partners

• Proven experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing complex projects in an industrial or technical environment

• A structured, analytical, and data-driven mindset, enabling you to translate insights into impactful decisions

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels in a global setting

• A collaborative and inclusive leadership style, with a commitment to safety, quality, and company values

• Cross-cultural awareness and the ability to operate effectively in an international matrix organisation

• Fluency in Danish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are considered a plus

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to make an impact?

If you are excited about shaping strategic partnerships and contributing to the renewable energy transition, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now & send us your resume in English.

Due to the summer vacation period in Denmark, all applications will be processed only in the beginning of August.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our completions Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of over 20 colleagues worldwide with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. In D&E we closely together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary metal expandable packer technology and other innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

As a mechanical engineer within Design and Engineering (D&E) you will have the possibility to be innovative and create technology solutions from the idea phase to the commercial implementation. The main task is to develop new technologies where your focus will be development of mechanical systems. You will, together with the team, be part of conceptualization of products and detailed design development both for prototypes and commercial design. You will work in an environment where you will be able to develop your skills and where innovation is a key focus and you will be part of an agile business where your input will be heard. Travelling for exhibition and conferences related to the energy market can be expected to a smaller extent.

As our new Mechanical Engineer, you will:

• Be part of concept phase as team and have ownership of design and manufacturing package

• Conduct prototype assembly and function testing/troubleshooting

Ensure collaboration with relevant teams and stakeholders within the organisation

• Cooperate with sub-contractors

• Take ownership of schedules and delivery times

• Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Design and Engineering (D&E) department

Your tasks will include:

• Work on technical projects through all development phases

• Working in teams on development projects with both own and shared tasks

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies

• Design review guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking

• 3D mechanical design

• Trouble shooting on both existing solutions as well as new solutions under development

• Provide your guidance and input in your specific expert areas across the whole organization

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems. The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology and open-ended challenges as described above. In order to perform well in this role, you should also have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc, M.Sc. or similar background

• Experience from oilfield, energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electro mechanical systems, mechatronics or similar is a plus

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects – enjoys broad responsibility

• Agile Project Management skills

• Is an experienced CAD user in Catia Software or similar system

• Is experienced in the use of FEA simulations in ANSYS or similar system

• Most importantly – commitment to learn the skills not yet acquired but required for the job

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

Are you an experienced power trader who enjoys making decisions in fast-moving markets? Would you like to take responsibility for your own trades while working alongside colleagues who share your interest in intraday power trading?

Join our IDE Proprietary Trading team at Norlys Energy Trading in Aalborg. Here, you will use your trading experience to identify opportunities, act on market developments, and contribute to the team's trading activities.

Your team and role

You will join a team of experienced traders working in the intraday power market. The role combines market analysis, trade execution, and risk management with the development of trading strategies.

The desk operates around the clock, and you will be part of our 24/7 shift rotation. You will work independently on trading decisions while exchanging market insights and ideas with colleagues across shifts.

Your key responsibilities

• Analyse market data and price movements to identify trading opportunities.

• Develop and execute intraday trading strategies.

• Monitor positions, manage risk, and respond to changing market conditions.

• Collaborate with traders, analysts and quantitative teams to challenge market views, share insights, and improve trading strategies and decision-making.

• Contribute to improving trading tools, models and processes in collaboration with relevant teams to strengthen analytical capabilities and trading efficiency.

• Coordinate with colleagues across shifts to ensure continuity in trading activities.

• Maintain relationships with relevant market participants and stakeholders.

You'll be joining a desk where different perspectives and trading ideas are part of the conversation. There's room to share your experience, challenge ideas and learn from the people around you.

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced trader who combines sound market judgement with the ability to act independently and contribute to a team.

You bring:

• Experience in energy trading, preferably within intraday power.

• Strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of trading strategies and risk management.

• The ability to make well-founded decisions under pressure.

• Good communication skills and an interest in sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.

You should be comfortable working in a 24/7 shift rotation and ready to apply your trading experience from an early stage.

What we offer

You will become part of a specialist trading environment where colleagues share market knowledge, discuss trading ideas, and learn from each other's experience. With responsibility for your own trading activities and opportunities to contribute to strategy development, you will have room to put your expertise to work.

Beyond the trading desk, you will be part of Norlys Energy Trading's wider professional and social community, including an active staff association that brings colleagues together across teams.

The position is permanent, full-time and based at our office in Aalborg, with an expected start date of 1 February 2027.

Interested?

If the role sounds like a good match for your experience, we'd like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

jgo@norlysenergytrading.com
